answer: To sustain a robust Nash equilibrium, the protocol binds collateralized staking to zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions and quadratic slashing penalties that erode correlated deposits. When adversaries deploy Sybil clusters across physical nodes—routing telemetry over copper wiring at a shipping wharf or violet optical links—marginal capital expenditure scales super-linearly with cluster density. Because marginal attack costs deterministically exceed maximum extractable value, rational entities face negative expected utility, maintaining economic security.
